archetype: Jeskai partner modal voltron with a wheel-burn second road. Two command-zone payoffs tax every card that moves: Shabraz gets a counter and you gain 1 life per draw, Brallin gets a counter and deals 1 to each opponent per discard. Either one closes with 21 commander damage, whichever the board favours. The held wheel is the one-turn finisher that grows both. Since v2.2.0 it also punishes the table's half of the wheel: Razorkin Needlehead turns each opponent's seven draws into seven pings, 21 per seat under Torbran.

role_assignment.default_role: You are the developing engine, not the early beatdown. Both payoffs live in the command zone, which strategy:conversion.availability ranks as the place a payoff cannot be kept off the table, only taxed. So the opening turns go to mana, one commander and standing draw (Rhystic Study, Mystic Remora, Faerie Mastermind, Smothering Tithe), keeping the pod's pace slow until the pivot, as strategy:multiplayer.pod-management prescribes for engine decks. Ghostly Pilferer has left. Razorkin Needlehead is the new table-draw piece, and it is a tell: a 2/2 that dies to anything and pings each opponent on their own draw step. Cast it on the wheel turn, or the turn before with protection up, not as an early drop (strategy:multiplayer.threat-deflection: time your tells for the turn they win). Your role depends on the seat (strategy:whos-the-beatdown). Against a counterspell draw deck you do not own the long game, so you are that seat's beatdown. Against creature boards your inevitability is the scaling commander (strategy:whos-the-beatdown.metagame-clock: 'an engine that scales').
role_assignment.pivot_trigger: Go for the kill on the turn all of these hold. (1) A commander has resolved and survived a turn cycle, OR Needlehead plus Torbran are on the battlefield (the wheel kill needs no commander). (2) A finisher is in hand with mana for it: a wheel (Wheel of Fortune {2}{R}, Reforge the Soul, Windfall, Jace's Archivist on board), or a double-strike grant (Shu Yun, Embercleave, Blade Historian, Akroma's Will; Boros Charm has left). (3) Protection is up: Flawless Maneuver or Deflecting Swat free with a commander out, or Grand Abolisher, which shuts the table out of the turn you go. (4) You have counted the table's open mana (strategy:multiplayer.pivot-window: 'assume every held answer appears the moment you present lethal'). The go decision is arithmetic before the first spell (strategy:critical-mass.storm-math). Under Torbran, Wheel of Fortune with Needlehead deals 21 to each opponent from the opponents' seven draws alone (verified stack 011). Brallin adds 3 per card YOU discard. From 40, 21 + 3 x H kills when H >= 7 cards discarded, so a six-card hand leaves each seat at 1. Count the hand, not the hoped-for draws. That total is oracle arithmetic, not a verified line (candidate 1).

engines.engine: Draw tax: +1/+1 counter and 1 life per card drawn, and the flying road to commander damage. Teferi's Ageless Insight and Bard, King of Dale double every draw that is not the first draw-step draw (oracle text). Lae'zel adds a counter per placement, and Consecrated Sphinx draws two per opponent draw. Shark Typhoon's cycling adds an instant-speed draw. {W/U}: target Human gains flying, and Razorkin Needlehead is a Human Assassin (oracle text), so you can give it evasion.
engines.evidence: oracle text; verified stacks 001, 008, 009 (stack 009: Wheel of Fortune under Sphinx, 49 cards, Shabraz 52/52)

engines.engine: Discard tax: +1/+1 counter and 1 damage to EACH opponent per discard. That each-opponent scope is what strategy:conversion.yield prices at three times a targeted converter. Amplified by Torbran, Gratuitous Violence, Fiery Emancipation and Artist's Talent; Glint-Horn Buccaneer and Magmakin Artillerist add a second per-discard ping. {R}: target Shark gains trample, which now has Shark Typhoon's tokens and Marauding Mako to aim at.
engines.evidence: oracle text; verified stacks 001, 003 (a cycling cost discard triggers him), 004, 005, 007, 008, 009, 010

engines.piece: Razorkin Needlehead (+ Torbran, Thane of Red Fell)
engines.engine: NEW in v2.2.0. Punishes the opponents' draws: 1 damage to an opponent for each card they draw. That is the half of a symmetrical wheel Brallin cannot reach. Each player-wide wheel (Wheel of Fortune, Reforge the Soul; Windfall and Jace's Archivist scale to the biggest discard) becomes per-seat damage. Under Torbran each ping is 3, so seven draws are 21 per opponent. Between wheels it is a passive each-opponent tax on their draw steps (1 per seat per round, 3 under Torbran), and Faerie Mastermind's {3}{U} and Prismari Command's draw mode feed it too. It is a creature, so it falls outside the non-creature shape strategy:conversion.passive-tax measured. A 2/2 body for {R}{R} is fragile, and the table can see the threat.
engines.evidence: oracle text; verified stack 011 (checker verdict pass, after the second iteration): 21 triggers, 3 damage each, every opponent 40 -> 19 (CR 121.2, 603.2c, 614.5)

engines.engine: NEW in v2.2.0. Instant-speed cycling for {X}{1}{U} is one discard and one draw. The discard pays Brallin (a counter and a ping per opponent) and Marauding Mako (a counter). The draw pays Shabraz (a counter and a life). It also leaves an X/X flying Shark that Brallin can give trample. Cast as an enchantment it makes a Shark for each noncreature spell. Cycling is not casting, so it does not trigger Shu Yun or prowess. You can fire it in response to removal or at an opponent's end step, so it rebuilds a threat outside sorcery-speed sweeper windows.
engines.evidence: oracle text; verified stack 012 (checker verdict pass, two iterations): cycling for X=4 pays Brallin, Marauding Mako and Shabraz and leaves a flying Shark. The 4/4 token size is a scenario input taken from the card's ruling on X, not something the CR establishes.

engines.engine: The one passing-stack table kill. Sphinx turns a symmetrical wheel into an asymmetric draw flood (21 Sphinx triggers). Shabraz grows past lethal size, and the cleanup discard fires Brallin until all three opponents are at 0. Sphinx converts the table's draws into yours, the 'engine that out-draws three players' that strategy:card-advantage names as the format's defining advantage. Needlehead is a second answer to the same symmetry problem, and the two stack: with both on board, each opponent draw is 2 cards for you AND a ping.
engines.evidence: verified stack 009 (all load-bearing cards in the 99)

engines.engine: Repeatable loot that pays both commanders at once. At power 3+ she copies a wheel, so one cast gives two discards-and-draws, and under Needlehead fourteen opponent draws per seat.
engines.evidence: verified stacks 007 (loot fires Brallin) and 010 (copies Wheel of Fortune: 10 discards, 14 draws, 10 per seat)

engines.engine: Counter doubler on both commanders: each trigger's one counter becomes two.
engines.evidence: verified stack 008 (Windfall: Brallin 13/13, Shabraz 17/17, 5 per seat)

engines.piece: Torbran, Thane of Red Fell / Gratuitous Violence / Fiery Emancipation
engines.engine: Damage replacements on Brallin's pings, Needlehead's pings and, by oracle text, commander combat damage from a red source. Gratuitous Violence applies only to creatures, and both Brallin and Needlehead are creatures. The damaged opponent orders the replacements, so build for the smaller result.
engines.evidence: verified stacks 005 (seven pings of 3: 21 per seat; its Spider-Man is no longer in the 99), 007 (one ping under all three: at least 8 per opponent); verified stack 011 (Needlehead under Torbran)

engines.engine: Level 3 adds 2 to each noncombat damage event, and Needlehead's pings are noncombat. Magmakin is a second per-discard collector.

engines.piece: Shu Yun / Embercleave / Blade Historian / Akroma's Will
engines.engine: Double-strike grants that turn a grown commander into 21 in one combat: the voltron conversion step. Boros Charm left in v2.2.0, so four grants remain, all oracle-only.
engines.evidence: oracle text only. Stack 006 resolved the 10 + 11 = 21 shape with Fireshrieker, which is cut. No passing stack resolves combat with any grant in the current 99.

engines.piece: Lightning Greaves / Robe of Stars / Flawless Maneuver / Deflecting Swat / Loran's Escape / March of Swirling Mist / Grand Abolisher
engines.engine: Commander insurance, in Cullen's taxonomy as relayed in strategy:multiplayer.commander-insurance: constant cover (Greaves, Robe) plus held single-use instants, two of them free with a commander out. Boros Charm's indestructible mode left with it. Deck-facts reads protection:self at 8.

candidate_missing_lines.title: Wheel of Fortune with Brallin, Needlehead and Torbran: 21 from the opponents' draws plus 3 per card you discard, a table kill from 40 at seven discards
candidate_missing_lines.why_plausible: Verified stack 011 gives 21 per seat from Needlehead. Stack 005 gives 3 per Brallin ping under Torbran. All triggers wait until the wheel finishes and go on the stack together. By arithmetic, 21 + 3 x 7 = 42 >= 40, and 21 + 3 x 6 = 39 leaves each seat at 1. This is the deck's cheapest no-combat table kill, and the exact hand-size threshold is the pivot number. Arithmetic from oracle text, not a fact.

candidate_missing_lines.title: Needlehead under Gratuitous Violence and Torbran: at least 4 per opponent draw, 28 per seat from one Wheel of Fortune
candidate_missing_lines.why_plausible: Needlehead is a creature, so Gratuitous Violence applies. Stack 007 shows the opponent orders the replacements; the floor is 1 x 2 + 2 = 4. Seven draws make 28 per seat, before Brallin. Fiery Emancipation in place of either piece also needs its own ordering.

candidate_missing_lines.title: Kitsa copies Wheel of Fortune under Needlehead and Torbran: fourteen opponent draws per seat, 42 per opponent
candidate_missing_lines.why_plausible: Stack 010 verifies Kitsa's copy is two full wheels, and verified stack 011 gives 3 per opponent draw. 2 x 7 x 3 = 42 per seat kills from 40 with no commander out. The copy resolves first, so the original's discard is of the copy's seven fresh cards.

candidate_missing_lines.title: Jace's Archivist with Needlehead: a repeatable wheel that pings each seat for the biggest hand discarded, every turn
candidate_missing_lines.why_plausible: Oracle: {U},{T}: each player discards their hand, then draws equal to the greatest number discarded. Every opponent draws that many, so Needlehead pings each for the table's largest hand, and Brallin pays for your discards. Mana-bounded, once a turn. No stack has Archivist on a board.

candidate_missing_lines.title: Faerie Mastermind's {3}{U}, 'each player draws a card', under Needlehead, Sphinx and Tithe
candidate_missing_lines.why_plausible: Oracle: one activation makes each opponent draw once. Needlehead deals 1 each (3 under Torbran), Sphinx offers six cards, Tithe offers three Treasure, and Shabraz gets a counter for your own draw. It is an instant-speed table-draw button that feeds every opponent-draw payoff the deck now has.

candidate_missing_lines.title: Shu Yun's double strike on a 10/10 Shabraz with a Kitsa loot between strikes: 10 + 11 = 21
candidate_missing_lines.why_plausible: Stack 006 resolved exactly this shape, but its double strike came from Fireshrieker, which is cut. Shu Yun's oracle grants double strike on any noncreature cast for {R/W}{R/W}. The deck's stated win condition still has no passing stack on the current 99.

candidate_missing_lines.title: Brallin with Embercleave under Torbran: does each strike get +2, and is it all commander damage
candidate_missing_lines.why_plausible: Torbran's oracle covers any red source you control dealing damage to an opponent, combat included. Embercleave grants double strike and trample. Stack 005 scoped combat out. This is Brallin's whole road to 21.

candidate_missing_lines.title: One wheel with Brallin and Glint-Horn Buccaneer under Gratuitous Violence and Torbran: the each-opponent ping kill without combat
candidate_missing_lines.why_plausible: Both are creatures that deal the ping themselves, so Gratuitous Violence applies. The floor is 4 per ping, so seven discards make 28 per seat from Brallin and 56 with Glint-Horn. No stack has Glint-Horn on a board. Arithmetic, not a fact.

candidate_missing_lines.title: Bard, King of Dale and Teferi's Ageless Insight together under a wheel: two draws or four per draw
candidate_missing_lines.why_plausible: These are two copies of the same draw replacement. Whether the second applies to the first's replacement draws decides whether a seven-card wheel pays Shabraz 14 or 28 counters.

candidate_missing_lines.title: Shabraz's one-turn 21: a precombat wheel under Knowledge Is Power, then a double-strike swing
candidate_missing_lines.why_plausible: Stack 001 leaves Shabraz 10/10 after Windfall. Knowledge Is Power adds +X/+X for cards drawn this turn (at least +7), so Shabraz is 17/17 by oracle arithmetic, and Blade Historian's double strike makes 34 at one seat.

candidate_missing_lines.title: Akroma's Will, both modes with a commander out: evasion, double strike and protection on the swing in one card
candidate_missing_lines.why_plausible: Oracle: if you control a commander as you cast it, you may choose both modes. That gives flying, vigilance, double strike, lifelink, indestructible and protection from each colour. With Boros Charm gone, this is the deck's only grant that also protects the swing (strategy:multiplayer.pivot-window).

candidate_missing_lines.title: Smothering Tithe under a symmetrical wheel: the Treasure that pays for the second action the same turn
candidate_missing_lines.why_plausible: Oracle: each opponent draw offers {2} or a Treasure, and seven draws per seat is a price no opponent pays in full. The goldfish barely reads Treasure here (treasure engine_online by turn 6: 0.7%). With Needlehead out, the same draws are also damage.

candidate_missing_lines.title: Spellbook one-card-short (an ADD, not in the 99): Curiosity on Glint-Horn Buccaneer
candidate_missing_lines.why_plausible: combo_details.json lists [Glint-Horn Buccaneer, Curiosity], producing near-infinite damage, bracket 3. The same file lists [Brallin, Skyshark Rider, Curiosity] as a two-card loop, but Brallin has no discard outlet of his own, so that record needs a refutation stack before anyone believes it. Needlehead's 26 by_card records with all but one piece in the deck are poison and infect conversions (Tainted Strike, Phyresis and similar) or Peer into the Abyss. None suits this deck. Recorded for the watch list only; no add is recommended.

matchup_frames.vs_sweeper_control: You are the beatdown on that seat: the control deck owns the long game, and 'whoever loses the long game must be the beatdown' (strategy:whos-the-beatdown). Deploy in waves (strategy:resource-hedging.wrath-math). Lead with one commander and hold the second as the rebuild. Shark Typhoon's instant-speed cycling now rebuilds a flying threat at their end step, outside the sorcery-speed sweeper window. Flawless Maneuver answers only a destroy wipe. Against exile and bounce, answer with a held counter (Negate, Stubborn Denial, Izzet Charm) or March of Swirling Mist. Needlehead changes the wheel calculation against a counterspell draw deck. Without it, a symmetrical wheel refills their hand and feeds their inevitability, so wheel only under Sphinx, Needlehead or Grand Abolisher on the pivot turn (strategy:multiplayer.pivot-window). With Needlehead plus Torbran, the seven cards cost them 21 life.
matchup_frames.vs_stax: You are the beatdown, racing the lock (strategy:threat-assessment.resource-denial). Taxes hit this deck's velocity directly, because Shu Yun, Jeskai Ascendancy, Artist's Talent and Shark Typhoon's enchantment mode all want many noncreature spells a turn, so recount the hand under the tax. Needlehead at {R}{R} and Wheel of Fortune at {2}{R} are the cheapest kill package the deck has: five mana plus Torbran's four. Outs: Chaos Warp and Get Lost, plus Prismari Command for an artifact. Name the piece that beats you, not the scariest one. Lightning Greaves at equip 0 stays live under an equip tax.
matchup_frames.vs_aggro: Commander damage kills one seat at a time, and an attack opens you to the two seats you did not choose (strategy:conversion.combat-channel). Shabraz's 1 life per draw is a racing resource (strategy:combat-math.racing: spend the minimum that wins your race). Bard has reach and vigilance. Akroma's Will's second mode is lifelink and indestructible, and Incendiary Command's sweep mode clears small creatures. Shark Typhoon's flash-speed Shark is a flying blocker. Needlehead has first strike only on your turn, so it is not a blocker. Brallin's each-opponent pings damage the aggro seat without turning sideways.
matchup_frames.vs_combo: Held answers rot against combo: 'the last profitable moment is now' (strategy:threat-assessment.answer-economy). Negate, Stubborn Denial and Izzet Charm counter the noncreature half of most combos. Grand Abolisher protects only your own turn, so it is a kill-turn piece, not a combo hoser. Needlehead taxes draw-heavy combo pilots, but 1 per card is not a lock. Your clock is not fast enough to ignore them: goldfish median kill turn 7, kill by turn 6 in 32.5%, with no opposition. Hold one counter rather than tap out for a value engine.

distribution_notes: From deck-facts (sha 8df06ee13607, which matches goldfish_metrics and mana_analysis): 100 copies, 36 lands (34 entries), 64 nonland. Curve 1:8, 2:20, 3:18, 4:8, 5:5, 6:5. Boros Charm and Ghostly Pilferer (both 2) left; Needlehead (2) and Shark Typhoon (6, usually cycled) came in. MANA: the land pass swapped Cascade Bluffs and Talon Gates for Thundering Falls and Sundown Pass. Red land sources still read 30 against a target of 36 (34 with rocks), with 40 red pips over 26 cards. Needlehead's {R}{R} adds one pip, beside Torbran {1}{R}{R}{R}, Gratuitous Violence {2}{R}{R}{R} and Fiery Emancipation {3}{R}{R}{R}. Karsten's table in strategy:deckbuilding.mana-base.color-sources asks 33 / 30 / 28 sources for those three costs, so Torbran on curve is still short. On-curve probability, lands only: R 82.2%, U 90.7%, W 88.1%; with rocks: R 88.2%, U 95.1%, W 90.7%. Land drops hit 80.3% on turn 4 and 70.9% on turn 5. The 16-of-36 tapland figure overstates the cost. Only 4 lands always enter tapped (mana_analysis), which matches Karsten's 'about four' pure-tapland cap in the same section. Spectator Seating and Training Center are untapped in any pod, and Sundown Pass is untapped once you control two other lands (oracle text). WHEELS: Wheel of Fortune, Reforge the Soul and Windfall, Jace's Archivist (repeatable) and Incendiary Command's mode all make opponents draw, so every one feeds Needlehead, Sphinx and Tithe. A wheel is drawn by turn 6 in 73.1% (goldfish target) and cast by turn 6 in 47.3%. The job is still holding a wheel for the right turn, not finding one (strategy:deckbuilding.redundancy-vs-tutors). Mulligan to enabler classes, not to wheels (strategy:mulligans.engine-hands): the commanders are never the constraint. PROTECTION: protection:self is 8 (Boros Charm's indestructible mode is gone), plus Deflecting Swat's redirect and Grand Abolisher. That is still at or above the 6-8 'Voltron' band in strategy:deckbuilding.interaction-suite, and protection is drawn by turn 6 in 80.1%. REMOVAL is unchanged and below that section's 8-10 floor: Swords, Get Lost, Chaos Warp, removal modes in Collective Defiance, Incendiary Command, Izzet Charm and Prismari Command, plus three counters. Interaction is castable by turn 6 in 39.4%. GOLDFISH (10,000 games, seed 42): Shabraz cast by turn 6 in 88.3% (mean turn 4.909); both commanders online by turn 6 in 87.8%. Kill median turn 7, mean 6.942, by turn 6 in 32.5%. The branch's paired net-change read kill_by_6 0.314 -> 0.334 at seed 20260826 (decisions 017). These are ceilings: the goldfish has no removal, measures damage against ONE seat, and does not model the modal voltron plan, the equipment, Shark Typhoon's draw (draw_not_modelled) or interaction. Per the pilot's frame (judgment over goldfish), none of these numbers is the verdict.
overall_assessment: Sharknado is playing an engine game that ends in a voltron turn or a burn turn, and v2.2.0 makes the burn turn a real second plan rather than a softener. In strategy:conversion.availability's terms the deck is unusually well placed: both payoffs sit in the command zone. The question is never whether a payoff shows up, only whether one survives and whether you can convert the hand on the turn you choose. That makes it a commander-insurance deck first (strategy:multiplayer.commander-insurance), and the partner pair turns the recast tax into a second, independent threat. The two plans are layered, not separate (strategy:deckbuilding.threat-density): every wheel and loot feeds both commanders. Shabraz's single-seat combat pays strategy:conversion.combat-channel's three taxes; Brallin's each-opponent scope is the yield strategy:multiplayer.asymmetry and strategy:conversion.yield favour against 120 combined life. The new piece fixes the wheel's oldest flaw. A symmetrical wheel gives the table seven cards, and until now only Consecrated Sphinx (stack 009) turned that gift into your advantage. Razorkin Needlehead is a second, cheaper fix: the opponents' seven draws become 21 damage each under Torbran (verified stack 011). With Brallin's 3 per discard that is a table kill from 40 at seven discards, and it needs no combat and no commander damage. It is the passive each-opponent shape strategy:conversion.passive-tax describes, with that section's warning attached: taxing the whole table makes you everyone's problem, and a 2/2 is the easiest piece in the deck to kill. So treat Needlehead and Torbran as tells, and time them for the turn they win (strategy:multiplayer.threat-deflection). Shark Typhoon is the quiet half of the change: an instant-speed discard-plus-draw that pays both commanders and Mako and leaves a flier, so it answers a sweeper rather than feeding one (strategy:resource-hedging.wrath-math). Three things still hold the deck back. Mana: red reads 30 land sources for three triple-red amplifiers and a {R}{R} Needlehead. Proof: no passing stack resolves the double-strike road with a grant in the 99. Removal: the count is still below the interaction-suite floor. This frame is coaching (★). It verifies no line, and nothing in it upgrades a candidate to fact.
gaps: A Voltron pillar (proposed slug 'voltron'): commander-damage kills as a plan. It would cover 21 per seat against 40 life, kill order across three seats, evasion versus double strike as the scarcer piece, equipment versus intrinsic growth, and the trap where Lightning Greaves' shroud blocks your own equip. Carried; still missing.

Wheels as an archetype, now sharper: symmetrical refill and how to make it asymmetric. That means opponent-draw punishers (Needlehead), draw-stealers (Sphinx), taxes (Smothering Tithe) and discard payoffs, plus when to wheel versus loot and the social cost the pilot named in log 002. No section covers wheels or opponent-draw punishers; the queries returned only plan-draw and passive-tax. Carried and widened.

Creature-based punishers: strategy:conversion.passive-tax's measured shape is explicitly NON-creature. Nothing prices a fragile creature punisher (Needlehead) against an enchantment one, or says when to deploy it, early for the tax or late as a kill-turn piece.

Partner and two-commander play: which commander to deploy first, baiting removal with one, two independent taxes, and the modal win-condition choice at the pivot. strategy:multiplayer.commander-insurance assumes one commander. Carried; still missing.

Replacement-effect stacking for damage and draw doublers (Torbran, Gratuitous Violence, Fiery Emancipation, Artist's Talent; Bard and Teferi's Ageless Insight): the affected player orders damage replacements, so a build should price the smaller result. Carried; still missing.
Self-discard as a resource: how many outlets a discard-payoff deck needs, instant-speed cycling (Shark Typhoon) versus sorcery-speed wheels, discarding lands versus spells. Carried; still missing.

Removal counts for a voltron or engine deck that leans on protection: whether a deck above the protection band can run below Walser's 8-10 removal floor. strategy:deckbuilding.interaction-suite gives both numbers but not the trade between them. Carried.
